answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity, whether trellis, comet, or shale, to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding on jobs. The bond cannot back another identity during that period, and a failed, objectively verifiable delivery forfeits it. Creating 1,000 eligible sybils therefore ties up $100,000 rather than merely requiring new keys; using them to submit fraudulent work also risks losing that capital.
